Tintori started his career as a screenwriter before moving behind the camera and founding the filmmaking collective Court 13. In addition to directing short films, Tintori was best known for his work on music videos featuring MGMT, Chairlift, The Cool Kids, The Killers, Arcade Fire and Solange Knowles .

Ray Tintori’s Family 
 Ray’s father, John Tintori , was a film editor who worked on Eight Men Out and Mr. Wonderful . His mother, Mary Cybulski , also worked in the entertainment industry as a script supervisor and photographer on projects such as Life of Pi, Syriana and The Ice Storm before she died in November 2025 at age 70 from glioblastoma.

“I grew up on film sets. My mom was a script supervisor and my dad was an editor. items.title: Fox Midseason 2027 TV Schedule Reveals Surprise Reduced Episode Order
items.summary:
Fox has released its midseason 2027 TV schedule with details on new additions and returning shows — and some major programming changes.

The network confirmed that existing shows would be back after the holidays to their usual time slots. Best Medicine , however, will have a reduced 14-episode order this season, which will pave the way for The Interrogator to take over in February.

There will also be new shows — including the highly anticipated Baywatch revival — to look forward to.

Baywatch, which ran from 1989 to 2001, followed lifeguards who worked on beaches in California (and Hawaii) while dealing with a variety of unexpected situations, from earthquakes and shark attacks to serial killers. At one point during its run in the ’90s, Baywatch made history as the most-watched television series in the world.

What to Know About 'Baywatch' Reboot — Including Which OG Stars Are Returning 

The series had dozens of cast shakeups over the years but ultimately turned into a cultural phenomenon. Some of the show’s memorable cast members include Nicole Eggert, Carmen Electra, David Hasselhoff, Billy Warlock, Alexandra Paul, Jeremy Jackson, Traci Bingham and Erika Eleniak .

In September 2025, Fox announced that a “reimagined” version of the iconic series is coming to the network, which will officially premiere next year. It will star Stephen Amell, Jessica Belkin, Hassie Harrison, Shay Mitchell, Thaddeus LaGrone, Noah Beck and Brooks Nader with cameos from OG Baywatch stars as well.

items.summary:
Good Morning America ‘s Gio Benitez is speaking out after receiving a “shocking” diagnosis.

Benitez, 41, opened up about his health during the Tuesday, November 17, episode of Good Morning America , revealing he was diagnosed with coronary artery disease after previously hinting at facing issues via social media. He recalled doing a coronary artery calcium scan, which is a noninvasive CT test that detects calcified plaque in the heart’s arteries, and receiving a score of 137.

“It shocked me because I feel totally fine,” he said on Tuesday while reflecting on the “surprising” and “really scary” news, which he received one week earlier. “I eat right, I exercise, I do all the right things.”

Benitez has since found out that he also has “borderline” cholesterol numbers. With other family members having a history of heart attacks, Benitez quickly became worried about his next steps.

Celebrity Health Scares Through the Years 

“I would lay down in bed and everything was silent … and I would just think, ‘Is this the night my heart stops?’” he recalled. “[My doctor] has assured me that is not the case. She has assured me we’re good, I’m going to live long.”

Arturo Holmes/Getty Images 
 Benitez, who is married to podcast host Tommy DiDario , elaborated on the diagnosis in an interview with People , saying, “I actually had panic attacks every night for about a week after I heard. My husband would go to sleep or I’d been in my hotel room, because I was traveling for work, and that’s when I would literally just start thinking the worst.”

items.title: I saw how brightly stars like Russell Brand could shine, but there is darkness in the shadows | Sophie Heawood
items.summary:
After years of celebrity interviews, I have learned not to be fooled by the allure of fame. We never really know them – we know what they want us to know

As I sat in Southwark crown court, listening to the final day of Russell Brand’s trial, there was one subject that came up repeatedly, invoked as often by his defence as the prosecution. I don’t mean sex or coercion, but fame. It ran through every victim impact statement and loomed so large in the courtroom that it felt as if it was almost on trial itself.

I’m an entertainment journalist who has been covering celebrities for more than 20 years – as long as Brand has been one – and I have written about him at various stages of his career. But I went to Southwark crown court as a member of the public who wanted to see justice done. For the women he had hurt, for the ones who couldn’t get as far as the courtroom, and for all of us who came of age at a time when rape culture was so fast and furious that young women mistook it for a joke that we were in on. In the age of lads’ mags, sex felt cheapened, yet somehow we were the ones who ended up paying for this. So it was doubly strange to sit in court and feel somehow complicit in it - in how this media culture had encouraged Russell Brand.

From Calvin Klein to British Vogue, the Real Madrid man is leading the way when it comes to football’s foray into fashion. But is he playing it safe?

This Sunday, Jude Bellingham will line up with his England teammates for a match against Spain. But the footballer has been hitting the headlines way beyond the pitch recently – thanks to fronting a Calvin Klein underwear ad released this month, and becoming the first footballer to appear solo on the cover of British Vogue.

It’s a savvy move for the 23-year-old, future-proofing himself as a power player both on and off the pitch. This is a roadmap carved out by David Beckham, who since retiring in 2013 has become a brand and personality that transcends sport. Beckham – together with his wife, Victoria – became a billionaire this year.

items.title: Russell Brand accused of misconduct by six more women, according to report
items.summary:
Allegations of sexual misconduct and predatory behaviour made against ex-comedian who was jailed on Monday

Russell Brand has been accused of sexual misconduct and predatory behaviour by a further six women, according to a report.

The comedian, 51, is accused of having sex with a woman without her consent and then apologising afterwards, an investigation by the Times and the Sunday Times said.
